1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 f5 3.Bc4 fxe4 4.Nxe5 Nf6 5.strategy: Takes the rook. The knight is stranded in the corner, but White is a rook up for now and can give some of it back to escape if Black's pieces become dangerous; calm development is all the position asks.

Hits the bishop and opens the c8-bishop, hoping for a swift attack on the queen and the king in the centre while the knight is stuck on h8. A calm Be2 keeps everything covered and leaves Black a rook down for too little.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 f5 3.Bc4 fxe4 4.Nxe5 Nf6 5.name: Latvian Gambit: Corkscrew Gambit
